text: すこしは　できる　みたいね！

structure.en: you can do at least a little

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたい after a verb means 'it looks like', a casual guess from what you saw. できる　みたい = 'it seems you are capable'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount means 'at least that much'. すこしは = 'a little, at least'.
